sentences.text: Unlike its relatives, modern gannets and boobies, Masillastega lived in freshwater environments.
The genus Masillastega was described by Mayr in 2002, and the only known species is Masillastega rectirostris.
Masillastega belongs to the family Sulidae.
Masillastega was an extinct aquatic bird that lived in Germany during the Eocene epoch, specifically between 48.07 and 41.03 million years ago during the Lutetian stage.
